Gifted: Afterimage.description:
🧬 Afterimage, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Leave a standing image of yourself behind, fake a lunge with an image of your body, or replay what you witnessed at life size a few strides away.
📈 Training adds a blinding stored glare, replays that show police what you saw, a false wall across an alley, a lit way out of smoke and a street full of your images.
⚠️ Your images are light only: no weight, no sound, no shadow, and anything that touches them passes straight through.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell, as your eyes glow with whatever you have stored and give away a coming projection.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Afterimage.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Afterimage family): Scale: the eyes store sight, projected as moving, full-color light. A new adult user keeps about the last ten minutes (rolling, unless a moment is kept) and projects any stored moment life-size anywhere visible within about ten meters, or their own figure, posed and moving at will; other images only replay sight, as seen. Larger, longer ones need techniques. Limits: light only: no weight, sound, touch, heat or shadow; things pass through. Solid by day; a glow betrays them in the dark. Fades if the user loses sight or focus; no unseen faces or places. Cameras record them. No beams, burning or hiding the user's body. Quirk Strain: light: standing image, feint; moderate: glare, replay, false wall; heavy: lit route, crowd of selves; severe: signature, projected battalion. Type: Emitter. Law: deceiving police or public is obstruction and fraud; showing real heroes or officers unlicensed is impersonation; a replay is sworn testimony, not a recording.
